messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about Social conditions and indicators in Berlin during the 1950s?
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.

queries: Berlin historische statistik 1950 1960 statistisches jahrbuch berlin digital daten
Berlin 1950s population housing employment statistics historical dataset
GESIS historische statistik Berlin 1950 soziale indikatoren daten
action.query: Berlin historische statistik 1950 1960 statistisches jahrbuch berlin digital daten

content.text: {"items":[{"title":"Berlin-Statistik: Historical Statistical Data for Berlin, 1950–1961","url_or_doi":"https://berlingeschichte.de/bms/bmstxt01/0103doka.htm","justification":"Highly relevant historical dataset containing population statistics for East Berlin, West Berlin, and Berlin as a whole during the 1950s. Includes population figures for 1950, 1953, 1955, 1957, 1958, 1959, and 1960, as well as geographical indicators. Particularly useful for examining demographic change, population distribution, and the effects of Berlin's political division."},{"title":"Berlin 1960 im Spiegel der Statistik (Berlin in Statistics, 1960)","url_or_doi":"https://berlingeschichte.de/bms/bmstxt01/0103proi.htm","justification":"Historical statistical comparison of social and demographic conditions in East and West Berlin around 1960, including figures from 1959 and earlier years. Contains indicators related to population health, mortality, causes of death, and suicide rates. Useful for investigating differences in living conditions and public health between the two halves of Berlin during the late 1950s."},{"title":"GESIS Regional Data for German Federal States, 1950–1987 (Regionaldaten Bundesländer)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.2472","justification":"Historical regional statistical dataset covering 1950–1987, including Berlin. Contains indicators related to employment, education, population, housing environments, crime, social services, economic conditions, and public expenditure. Particularly valuable for comparing Berlin's social conditions with those of other German regions. Researchers should verify which variables and years are available specifically for Berlin."},{"title":"GESIS: Population, Population Changes, Households and Families in Germany, 1947–1999","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA8200?doi=10.4232%2F1.8200","justification":"Historical demographic dataset covering the entire 1950s. Includes population statistics, household characteristics, family structures, and demographic changes. Based on official German population statistics and census-related sources. Relevant for studying household composition, family formation, and demographic trends in postwar Berlin, although Berlin-specific coverage should be checked for individual variables."},{"title":"Statistisches Jahrbuch der Deutschen Demokratischen Republik (Statistical Yearbooks of East Germany, 1955–1959)","url_or_doi":"https://digi.bib.uni-mannheim.de/sammlungen/statistische-jahrbuecher","justification":"Digitized collection of official East German statistical yearbooks, including editions published annually from 1955 onward. Provides historical information about population, employment, education, healthcare, housing, and economic conditions. Useful for researching social conditions in East Berlin within the broader context of East Germany. Berlin-specific tables must be identified within individual yearbooks."},{"title":"GESIS HISTAT: Historical Statistics Database","url_or_doi":"https://dbis.uni-regensburg.de/UBEN/resources/10112","justification":"Historical statistical database containing more than 250,000 time series from studies of German economic and social history. Covers demographic, economic, and social developments across historical periods, including the 1950s. Potentially valuable for finding longitudinal indicators relating to employment, population, welfare, and living standards. Berlin-specific series require additional searching within the database."},{"title":"Statistisches Jahrbuch Berlin 1999: Historical Population Statistics","url_or_doi":"https://www.statistischebibliothek.de/mir/servlets/MCRFileNodeServlet/BBAusgabe_derivate_00000385/Stat_Jahrbuch_j99_BEa.pdf","justification":"Official Berlin statistical yearbook containing retrospective demographic tables, including population by district and sex for 1950. Provides historical reference figures for comparing population distributions across Berlin's districts before and after the city's political division. Particularly useful for studying demographic geography and establishing a baseline for social analysis of 1950s Berlin."},{"title":"System of Social Indicators for Germany: Health (System sozialer Indikatoren, Lebensbereich Gesundheit)","url_or_doi":"https://b2find.eudat.eu/dataset/81c66fe6-3b41-5f5c-a7fa-252d9440c352","justification":"Historical social-indicator dataset containing time series on health and healthcare conditions, with some indicators extending back to 1950. Useful for investigating public health, mortality, and medical services during the postwar period. Primarily provides national-level indicators, so its usefulness for Berlin-specific research depends on the availability of regional breakdowns."},{"title":"Statistik der Bundesrepublik Deutschland: Historical Statistical Publications","url_or_doi":"https://www.statistischebibliothek.de/mir/servlets/MCRFileNodeServlet/DEHeft_derivate_00064783/StatBRD_50.pdf","justification":"Digitized historical statistical publication containing early postwar German statistics and references to Berlin-specific statistical material, including housing data from Berlin in Zahlen (1951). Relevant for investigating residential conditions, housing availability, and reconstruction during the early 1950s. Particularly useful as a source of historical statistical tables and references to additional Berlin datasets."}]}
